Scope Gate.rationale: Independent BA assessment: scope faithfully bounds CKA-02 (payload packaging, bundled-source fallback with preserved precedence, metadata regeneration); acceptance criteria measurable and match ticket verbatim; only low-severity finding (count-parity vs set-parity) already tracked as open question Q-001.

Planning Gate.rationale: Independent tech-lead assessment: 10-task breakdown feasible and correctly sequenced (acyclic graph, waves match edges); both verbatim ticket criteria mapped; risks credible; no blocking defect. Minor findings: make T-006 include durable regression tests for the find_source fallback (carried to design/implementation), record T-008 assurance decision before T-006 (edge-enforced).

Design Gate.rationale: Independent tech-lead assessment under producer exclusion: factual register verified against repo (pyproject, find_source candidate order, MANAGED_DIRS/EXCLUDE_PATTERNS, installer guard); selected package-data option feasible, fallback preserves precedence and error path; ADRs D-001/D-002 accepted; all ten plan tasks bound. Minor: resolve Q-003 (bundle sync verification) before P-003 completes; sdist may also need MANIFEST.in per setuptools version, caught by C-007 inspection.

Review Gate.rationale: Independent QA assessment under producer exclusion: review package complete, its single finding verifiably resolved (regenerated metadata set-identical to bundle), evidence reproduced under independent rerun (316 tests green, real-wheel walkthrough). No blocking finding.

Verification Gate.rationale: Independent QA re-execution: all six acceptance criteria A-001..A-006 met with executed evidence (316 tests green; wheel sha256 match with 267 payload files and zero exclusion hits; venv validate V-OK; dry-run parity 253/17 both paths; egg-info payload entries set-identical to bundle). Mirror-sync risk controlled by parity tests; three pre-existing proof-script failures attributed to unrelated governance debt, not this change. Merge-ready.

Closure Gate.rationale: Independent orchestrator assessment under producer exclusion: release note faithful to delivered behavior with honest known issues (K-001..K-008 incl. stale-mirror window and dot-glob gap); all six phases completed, all five prior gates decided by eligible non-producer owners; handoff items tracked with owners. Low finding: releaseVerdict front-matter vs body wording tension, disambiguated by the 0+CKA-02-unreleased version string.
